title: Stephanie B Probable NDE 9101
content: I was given a drug that was laced with fentanyl. I knew immediately afterwards that I was going to die. I fell backwards and continued falling for what seemed like forever. I saw glimpses of my life from the very beginning and only visions of everything I had ever done wrong. I kept falling until I found myself in the middle of the city where I was born. It looked like the city had been hit by a bomb and I was the only person there. I had an overwhelming feeling that I was in Hell. I had been shown the reasons why God sent me to Hell while I was falling. I knew that I had caused myself this outcome and I knew it was too late to change. Then suddenly I was back in my body and I was alive! I was so excited and grateful for God blessing me with this wake up call. I have gone from questioning if God existed; to sharing this story with others in hope of it changing other people's lives. I was shown that if I didn't get my life together now, I would spend eternity suffering in Hell. Heaven has to exist because I know for sure that I've been to hell. I know I never want to spend eternity living alone with nothing but my mistakes and guilt holding me down. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 2017 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Drug or medication overdose. I was given a drug laced with fentanyl How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely distressing Did you feel separated from your body? No How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Less consciousness and alertness than normal. I was dead. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Unconscious and not breathing Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual. I saw my life in both slow and fast motion Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I saw my entire life in flashes Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I could hear nothing Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Guilt Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? No Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about myself or others. I knew that I was in hell and God showed me what I did to get there Did scenes from your past come back to you? My past flashed before me, out of my control. I was shown all my sins while falling to hell Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Religious unaffiliated Have your religious practices changed since your experience? I am a Christian now. What is your religion now? Christian- Other Christian Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I had always questioned my faith, but I was shown that I was wrong to question the lord. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I now have no doubt about God being real. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Uncertain. I know for certain that god does exist During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes I have no more doubts about God after being to hell and then being given one last opportunity to save my eternity. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I was shown to love and accept everyone equally During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Unknown. I was sent to what I thought is hell and it looked to be the Earth after God has taken the people who are going to heaven off. It looks like the world had been hit with a bomb and there was nobody there but me. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? Yes We must forgive in order to be forgiven when our day comes for judgment. During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes I've learned forgiveness and loyalty from my experience What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. I quit doing drugs and living life for the moment Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Being shown that hell exists and then given a chance to change where I end up spending eternity Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Immediately but people just think that I am making it up. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Uncertain. I didn't believe in it previously What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Yes Did the questions asked and information that you provided accurately and comprehensively describe your experience? Uncertain Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? I value myself now

tunnel.movement_other_detail: She reported continuing to fall for what seemed like forever.

environment.environment_other_detail: She found herself in the middle of the city where she was born; it looked like it had been hit by a bomb and she was the only person there.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She reported being shown to "love and accept everyone equally" and that "we must forgive in order to be forgiven"; she also describes it as a wake-up call to change her life.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drug or medication overdose (given a drug laced with fentanyl).

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Religiously unaffiliated prior to the experience; Christian (Other Christian) after.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: She described prolonged falling, then arriving in a devastated version of her birth city with a sense of being in hell, then an abrupt return to her body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel/light/beings; falling preceded a negative life review and arrival in a hell-like environment, followed by sudden return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She reported "falling" for what seemed like forever and arriving in the bombed-out city where she was born, alone, interpreted as hell.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I fell backwards and continued falling for what seemed like forever.”; “It looked like the city had been hit by a bomb and I was the only person there.”; “I had an overwhelming feeling that I was in Hell.”; “Then suddenly I was back in my body and I was alive!”
